notes.title: The camping park of your dreams
notes.notes:
Get ready for the adventure of a lifetime this summer! Grab your tent and join us by the fire for the ultimate experience in the First DevLog of Camping Park Simulator.

Discover what makes Camping Park Simulator truly unique: an immersive game designed to take you on a wild holiday along America's Route 66.

As you embark on your journey, be prepared to roll up your sleeves and start renovating and refurbishing the entire campsite. The structures and attractions you build will be crucial in attracting more tourists to your site, so plan your strategies carefully!

But don't be fooled, along the way, you'll encounter some disgruntled and spoiled travelers. However, there will also be those who appreciate your hospitality and leave with a smile on their faces.

Let Camping Park Simulator take you on a nostalgic journey, reliving or imagining carefree summer days from your youth.

Don't hesitate any longer and add Camping Park Simulator to your Wishlist now!

And hey, if you're in the mood for engaging chats on topics like games, simulators, motorization, travels, and beyond, then join our Discord community.

See you in the next DevLog!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404870/Camping_Park_Simulator/
